inputs.text: John Lahart is right that people without children should not be treated as less deserving of fairness. But that cannot become a pretext to weaken the right of families to pass on what they have worked to build. Inheritance is more than privilege: it is a way parents and relatives support the next generation and preserve a family’s security. A fair system should respect different family circumstances without turning every family legacy into an excuse for greater state control or redistribution.

output.main_topic: Balancing fairness for people without children with families’ inheritance rights
